integrity: Full face and incidence enumeration, a complete acyclic matching, and the signed integral Morse boundary are reproduced by standalone standard-library Python code. The displayed computation is an exhaustive finite certificate, not an independent external audit.
scientific_limitations: The homotopy classification is confined to the first higher-independence complex of the 24-vertex Nauru graph; no equivariant type or general graph-family result is asserted. Publication priority and independent review remain open.
title: A mixed-dimensional integral sphere wedge for the Nauru two-independence complex
